parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert integration
parameters.name: integration_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert integration
parameters.name: integration_name

parameters.help_en:
The service of the alert integration. Valid values:

CLOUD_MONITOR: CloudMonitor
LOG_SERVICE: Log Service
parameters.help_zh:
集成产品类型：

CLOUD_MONITOR：云监控
LOG_SERVICE：日志服务
parameters.name: integration_product_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the alert integration
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically clear alert events. Valid values:

true (default)
false
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件是否自动恢复：

true（默认）
false

parameters.help_en: The fields whose values are deduplicated

parameters.help_en:

true

事件映射，将源字段映射到目标字段。

parameters.help_en:
The field for clearing alert events. The system queries alert events based on the field of alert clearing events and clears the alert events.

Only the Log Service alert integration supports the parameter
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件恢复字段。系统收到恢复事件后会根据恢复事件中的字段查询告警事件进行恢复。

仅日志服务支持设置此参数
parameters.name: initiative_recover_field

parameters.help_en:
The value of the field for clearing alert events. The system queries alert events based on the field of alert clearing events and clears the alert events.

Only the Log Service alert integration supports the parameter
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件恢复字段值。系统收到恢复事件后会根据恢复事件中的字段查询告警事件进行恢复。
仅日志服务支持设置此参数
parameters.name: initiative_recover_value
